clio:french-mandate-for-syria-and-lebano.wikipedia: Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon

clio:haudenosaunee.name: Haudenosaunee
clio:haudenosaunee.note: Approximate extent of Haudenosaunee (Six Nations) lands in the United States and Upper Canada.

clio:house-of-tocco.name: House of Tocco
clio:house-of-tocco.wikipedia: County Palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos

altNames: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

clio:maderistas.wikipedia: List of factions in the Mexican Revolution

clio:muhammad-ali-dynasty.name: Muhammad Ali dynasty
clio:muhammad-ali-dynasty.wikipedia: History of Egypt under the Muhammad Ali dynasty

clio:sovereign-principality-of-the-unite.name: Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands
clio:sovereign-principality-of-the-unite.wikipedia: Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands

clio:taifa-of-santa-maria-do-algarve.name: Taifa of Santa Maria do Algarve
clio:taifa-of-santa-maria-do-algarve.wikipedia: Taifa of Santa Maria do Algarve

clio:united-kingdoms-of-sweden-and-norwa.name: United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway

clio:united-principalities-of-moldavia-a.name: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia
clio:united-principalities-of-moldavia-a.wikipedia: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia

ne:abw.name: Aruba
ne:abw.note: Constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands since 1 January 1986 (status aparte).

ne:aia.name: Anguilla
ne:aia.note: Separate British dependent territory from 19 December 1980; British Overseas Territory.

ne:blm.name: Saint-Barthélemy
ne:blm.note: French overseas collectivity since 15 July 2007; left the EU (OCT status) in January 2012.

ne:blz.name: Belize
ne:blz.note: Independent since 21 September 1981. Guatemala recognised Belize in 1991 but keeps a territorial claim, before the International Court of Justice since 2019.

ne:bmu.name: Bermuda
ne:bmu.note: British colony; officially a 'British Dependent Territory' from 1 January 1983 and a 'British Overseas Territory' since the 2002 Act. On the UN list of non-self-governing territories since 1946. Independence was rejected in the referendum of 16 August 1995 (74% no). The US military presence (from the Second World War) lasted until 1995 and was no transfer of sovereignty.

ne:brb.name: Barbados
ne:brb.note: Independent 30 November 1966; republic within the Commonwealth since 30 November 2021.

ne:clp.name: Clipperton Island
ne:clp.note: French possession by the arbitral award of King Victor Emmanuel III (1931), accepted by Mexico (constitution amended 18 January 1934). Administered by the High Commissioner in French Polynesia until 21 February 2007, then directly by the Minister of Overseas France. Uninhabited since the last US Navy weather-station staff left on 21 October 1945.

ne:cnm.name: United Nations Buffer Zone in Cyprus
ne:cnm.wikipedia: United Nations Buffer Zone in Cyprus

ne:cuw.name: Curaçao
ne:cuw.note: Constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands since 10 October 2010.

ne:cym.name: Cayman Islands
ne:cym.note: Direct British dependency from Jamaican independence (1962); British Overseas Territory.

ne:flk.name: Falkland Islands
ne:flk.note: British colony / Overseas Territory; claimed by Argentina.

ne:grl.name: Greenland
ne:grl.note: Self-government from 21 June 2009 (self-rule over judicial affairs, policing and natural resources).

ne:kab.name: Baikonur
ne:kab.note: Cosmodrome and town leased to and administered by Russia (lease of December 1994 for 20 years with a 10-year option, extended in 2005 to 2050); Kazakhstan retains sovereignty.

ne:kna.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
altNames: Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis

ne:lby.name: Libya
altNames: Great Socialist People's Libyan Arab Jamahiriya

ne:msr.name: Montserrat
ne:msr.note: British colony, now a British Overseas Territory.

ne:pri.name: Puerto Rico
altNames: Estado Libre Asociado de Puerto Rico
ne:pri.note: US commonwealth (unincorporated territory) under the constitution of 25 July 1952.

ne:prk.name: North Korea
altNames: Provisional People's Committee of North Korea

ne:sgs.name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
ne:sgs.wikipedia: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

ne:spm.name: Saint Pierre and Miquelon
ne:spm.note: A French overseas collectivity (collectivité d'outre-mer) with a special status since March 2003.

ne:sxm.name: Sint Maarten
ne:sxm.note: Constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands since 10 October 2010.

ne:tca.name: Turks and Caicos Islands
ne:tca.note: Crown colony from August 1962 (Bahamas governor 1965–1973, own governor 1973); British Overseas Territory.

ne:usa.name: United States
ne:usa.note: US possession claimed under the Guano Islands Act; US Weather Bureau hurricane station (from 1938), CIA-run Radio Swan in the early 1960s. Honduras claimed the islands. The United States recognised Honduran sovereignty in the Treaty on the Swan Islands (San Pedro Sula, 22 November 1971); Honduran title took effect on 1 September 1972.

ne:usg.name: Guantanamo Bay Naval Base
ne:usg.note: Leased to the United States (1903 lease, 1934 treaty): the US exercises jurisdiction and control, Cuba retains ultimate sovereignty.

ne:vgb.name: British Virgin Islands
ne:vgb.note: Separate colony from 1956 (separate crown colony with the end of the Leeward governorship, 1960); did not join the West Indies Federation; British Overseas Territory.

ne:vir.name: United States Virgin Islands
altNames: Virgin Islands of the United States
ne:vir.note: Unincorporated territory of the United States (purchased from Denmark in 1917).

ovr:anguilla-secession.name: Anguilla (British-administered; claimed by Saint Christopher-Nevis-Anguilla)
ovr:anguilla-secession.note: British Commissioner from March 1969; formally separated 19 December 1980.

ovr:bajo-nuevo-bank-dispute.name: Bajo Nuevo Bank (disputed)
ovr:bajo-nuevo-bank-dispute.note: ICJ upheld Colombian sovereignty (2012); the US Guano Islands Act claim stands. Natural Earth also lists Jamaica as a claimant (start date unverified; 1993 joint regime area with Colombia).

ovr:beagle-channel-islands-dispute.name: Picton, Lennox and Nueva (claimed by Argentina)
ovr:beagle-channel-islands-dispute.note: Chilean-held; Argentine claim from 1904; 1977 award to Chile rejected by Argentina on 25 January 1978; settled by the Treaty of Peace and Friendship (signed 29 November 1984, in force 2 May 1985).

ovr:brazilian-island-dispute.name: Brazilian Island (claimed by Uruguay)
ovr:brazilian-island-dispute.note: Administered by Brazil; Uruguay claims it since 1940 (protest of 8 September 1940).

ovr:british-honduras.name: Belize
ovr:british-honduras.note: The self-governing colony of British Honduras was renamed Belize on 1 June 1973; it remained a British colony until independence on 21 September 1981.

ovr:chechen-republic-of-ichkeria.name: Chechen Republic of Ichkeria
ovr:chechen-republic-of-ichkeria.note: Unrecognised Chechen state: independence declared 1 November 1991; de facto independent 1991–1994 and 1996–1999; government in exile after 2000.

ovr:chechnya-dispute.name: Chechnya (Ichkeria; claimed by Russia)
altNames: Chechnya (held by Russia; contested by Ichkeria)
ovr:chechnya-dispute.note: De facto independent after the Khasavyurt Accord (31 August 1996) and the 1997 peace treaty; Russian forces re-entered on 1 October 1999 and held the northern lowlands at the end of 1999; Grozny fell on 6 February 2000.

ovr:cherokee-nation.name: Cherokee Nation
ovr:cherokee-nation.note: Approximate extent of the Cherokee Nation in Indian Territory (Royce, Indian Land Cessions, 1899).

ovr:chickasaw-nation.name: Chickasaw Nation
ovr:chickasaw-nation.note: Approximate extent of Chickasaw Nation lands in Indian Territory, 1855-1906.

ovr:choctaw-nation.name: Choctaw Nation
ovr:choctaw-nation.note: Approximate extent of Choctaw Nation lands in Indian Territory (Choctaw District), 1837-1906.

ovr:crimea-dispute.name: Crimea (annexed by Russia; claimed by Ukraine)
ovr:crimea-dispute.wikipedia: Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation
ovr:crimea-dispute.note: Seized by Russian forces from 27 February 2014 and incorporated on 18 March 2014; UN General Assembly resolution 68/262 affirms Ukraine’s territorial integrity.

ovr:dominion-of-newfoundland.name: Dominion of Newfoundland
ovr:dominion-of-newfoundland.note: A dominion whose self-government had been suspended in 1934: ruled by a Commission of Government appointed by the United Kingdom, the governor reporting to London. It comprised the island of Newfoundland and Labrador (boundary of the 1927 Privy Council decision). After the referendums of 3 June and 22 July 1948 it joined Canada in the last hours of 31 March 1949.

ovr:donetsk-peoples-republic.name: Donetsk People’s Republic
ovr:donetsk-peoples-republic.note: Self-proclaimed in April 2014 in eastern Ukraine, unrecognised (Russia recognised it on 21 February 2022); widely described as a Russian puppet state; annexed by Russia on 30 September 2022.

ovr:donetsk-peoples-republic-dispute.name: Donetsk People’s Republic (separatist-held; claimed by Ukraine)
ovr:donetsk-peoples-republic-dispute.note: Russian-backed separatist area of Donetsk Oblast (line after February 2015); from 2022 within Russian-held Ukraine (0004–0008).

ovr:embera-wounaan.name: Emberá-Wounaan
ovr:embera-wounaan.note: Indigenous territory of the Emberá and Wounaan peoples, created by Law 22 of 8 November 1983 from Darién in two separate districts (Cémaco and Sambú); governed by its General Congress. Natural Earth's polygon: 4,014 km2 against the official 4,383.5 km2.

ovr:falkland-islands-sovereignty-dispute.name: Falkland Islands (claimed by Argentina)
ovr:falkland-islands-sovereignty-dispute.note: British-administered since 1833 (except 2 April – 14 June 1982); claimed by Argentina as the Islas Malvinas.

ovr:french-territory-of-the-afars-and-th.name: French Territory of the Afars and the Issas
ovr:french-territory-of-the-afars-and-th.wikipedia: French Territory of the Afars and the Issas

ovr:guantanamo-bay-dispute.name: Guantanamo Bay Naval Base (contested by Cuba)
ovr:guantanamo-bay-dispute.note: US-leased since 1903; since 1959 Cuba regards the US presence as illegal and has not cashed the rent.

ovr:guatemalan-claim-to-belize.name: Guatemalan claim to southern Belize
ovr:guatemalan-claim-to-belize.note: Since its letter of 18 October 1999 Guatemala claims the land between the Sibun and Sarstoon rivers (12,272 km2, about 53% of Belize) together with cays and maritime areas. Natural Earth's disputed area B51 (about 7,960 km2) is narrower: it leaves out most of the Maya Mountains and the cays. Adjacency zone agreed 8 November 2000; Special Agreement 8 December 2008; ICJ seised in June 2019 after referendums in Guatemala (15 April 2018) and Belize (8 May 2019); oral hearings set for February 2027.

ovr:guayana-esequiba.name: Guayana Esequiba (claimed by Venezuela)
ovr:guayana-esequiba.note: Administered by Guyana; claimed by Venezuela (Zona en Reclamación; “Guayana Esequiba” state by Venezuelan law of 2024). Before the ICJ since 2018.

ovr:guna-yala.name: Guna Yala
ovr:guna-yala.note: Name Guna Yala recognised by the Government of Panama in October 2011.

ovr:hans-island.name: Hans Island
ovr:hans-island.note: Divided by the agreement signed in Ottawa on 14 June 2022 along a north–south ravine (western ~40% to Canada, eastern ~60% to Denmark/Greenland). Denmark ratified on 19 December 2023; Canada had not yet ratified in February 2025 (its Arctic Foreign Policy of 6 December 2024 promised to finalize the agreement) and no entry into force was found, so the base layer still follows Natural Earth (see m-north-central-america-0009).

ovr:kuril-islands-dispute.name: Southern Kuril Islands (claimed by Japan)
ovr:kuril-islands-dispute.note: Administered by Russia; claimed by Japan as its Northern Territories.

ovr:leeward-islands.name: Leeward Islands
altNames: Federal Colony of the Leeward Islands

ovr:luhansk-peoples-republic.name: Luhansk People’s Republic
ovr:luhansk-peoples-republic.note: Self-proclaimed in April–May 2014 in eastern Ukraine, unrecognised (Russia recognised it on 21 February 2022); often described as a Russian puppet state; annexed by Russia on 30 September 2022.

ovr:luhansk-peoples-republic-dispute.name: Luhansk People’s Republic (separatist-held; claimed by Ukraine)
ovr:luhansk-peoples-republic-dispute.note: Russian-backed separatist area of Luhansk Oblast; from 2022 within Russian-held Ukraine (0004–0008).

ovr:meanguera.name: Meanguera
ovr:meanguera.note: The General Peace Treaty of Lima (30 October 1980) left the legal situation of the islands ('la situación jurídica insular') to the El Salvador–Honduras Joint Boundary Commission (art. 18.4) and, failing agreement within five years, to the ICJ (art. 31); the Special Agreement was filed with the Court on 11 December 1986, and its Chamber decided the Gulf of Fonseca islands on 11 September 1992. El Salvador had claimed Meanguera and Meanguerita in a diplomatic note of 12 October 1854 and its presence there grew from the late 19th century. Honduras claimed both before the Court, but its protest of 1991 came too late to affect the presumption of acquiescence, and the Chamber held them Salvadoran (Meanguerita as a dependency of Meanguera). The small islet of Meanguerita is not in Natural Earth's land.

ovr:muscogee-creek-nation.name: Muscogee (Creek) Nation
ovr:muscogee-creek-nation.note: Approximate extent of Muscogee (Creek) Nation lands in Indian Territory after the 1866 treaty.

ovr:ngabe-bugle.name: Ngäbe-Buglé
ovr:ngabe-bugle.note: Collective territory of the Ngäbe and Buglé peoples, created by Law 10 of 7 March 1997 from parts of Bocas del Toro, Chiriquí and Veraguas; governed by its General Congress and Cacique General. Natural Earth's polygon: 6,133 km2 against about 6,968 km2.

ovr:panama-canal-zone.name: Panama Canal Zone
ovr:panama-canal-zone.note: Administered by the United States under the 1903 Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty, which gave it rights "as if it were sovereign" (Panama kept titular sovereignty); reported to the UN as a non-self-governing territory in 1946–1947. Abolished on 1 October 1979 under the Torrijos–Carter Treaties; the canal itself passed to Panama on 31 December 1999. Approximate boundary: 5 miles each side of the canal centreline and 3 miles out to sea, Gatun Lake to the 100-ft contour and Madden Lake included, the cities of Panama and Colón excluded.

ovr:republic-of-anguilla.name: Republic of Anguilla
ovr:republic-of-anguilla.note: Unrecognised: Anguillans expelled the St Kitts police on 30 May 1967 and voted to secede on 11 July 1967.

ovr:rincon-de-artigas.name: Rincón de Artigas (claimed by Uruguay)
ovr:rincon-de-artigas.note: Administered by Brazil (Santana do Livramento); Uruguay has contested the identification of the Arroyo de la Invernada since 1934.

ovr:roncador-cay-dispute.name: Roncador Cay (disputed)
ovr:roncador-cay-dispute.note: Ceded by the US to Colombia on 17 September 1981 (Vásquez-Saccio Treaty); Nicaraguan claim until the ICJ judgment of 19 November 2012.

ovr:russian-occupied-ukraine.name: Russian-occupied Ukraine
ovr:russian-occupied-ukraine.note: Held by Russia on 30 September 2026 (DeepStateMap); annexation of the Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson oblasts proclaimed 30 September 2022, declared invalid by UN General Assembly resolution ES-11/4.

ovr:san-andres-providencia-dispute.name: San Andrés and Providencia (claimed by Nicaragua)
ovr:san-andres-providencia-dispute.note: Nicaragua declared the 1928 Esguerra–Bárcenas Treaty invalid in 1980; the ICJ held on 13 December 2007 that the treaty settled sovereignty in Colombia’s favour.

ovr:sapodilla-cayes.name: Sapodilla Cayes
ovr:sapodilla-cayes.note: Administered by Belize; claimed by Honduras in its 1982 constitution and by Guatemala. Belize v. Honduras is before the ICJ since 16 November 2022, with Guatemala admitted as an intervener on 19 March 2026.

ovr:seminole-nation.name: Seminole Nation
ovr:seminole-nation.note: Approximate extent of Seminole Nation lands in Indian Territory, 1866-1906.

ovr:serranilla-bank-dispute.name: Serranilla Bank (disputed)
ovr:serranilla-bank-dispute.note: ICJ upheld Colombian sovereignty (2012; accepted by Nicaragua in a 2014 constitutional amendment); the US Guano Islands Act claim stands. Natural Earth still lists Honduras, and Jamaica’s claim (start date unverified) was largely resolved by the 1993 Joint Regime Area; neither is listed for these years.

ovr:southern-patagonian-ice-field.name: Southern Patagonian Ice Field (undemarcated)
ovr:southern-patagonian-ice-field.note: Boundary between Argentina and Chile not demarcated; administered by neither state.

ovr:southern-patagonian-ice-field-disput.name: Southern Patagonian Ice Field (Argentina / Chile, undemarcated)
ovr:southern-patagonian-ice-field-disput.note: Boundary between Mount Fitz Roy and Cerro Murallón undefined; neither state effectively administers the area.

ovr:swan-islands.name: Swan Islands
ovr:swan-islands.note: Held by the United States (Guano Islands Act claim; weather station; Radio Swan), claimed by Honduras; the 1971 Treaty on the Swan Islands gave Honduras clear title from 1 September 1972.

ovr:territory-of-alaska.name: Territory of Alaska
ovr:territory-of-alaska.note: Organised incorporated territory of the United States (24 August 1912 – 3 January 1959), reported to the UN as a non-self-governing territory 1946–1959; admitted as the 49th state on 3 January 1959.

ovr:territory-of-hawaii.name: Territory of Hawaii
ovr:territory-of-hawaii.note: Organised incorporated territory of the United States (1900 – 21 August 1959), reported to the UN as a non-self-governing territory 1946–1959; admitted as the 50th state on 21 August 1959. Palmyra, Midway, Kingman Reef, Johnston Atoll and Sand Island were excluded from the state (NE unit UMI).

ovr:territory-of-papua-and-new-guinea.name: Territory of Papua and New Guinea
ovr:territory-of-papua-and-new-guinea.wikipedia: Territory of Papua and New Guinea

ovr:tiger-island.name: Tiger Island
ovr:tiger-island.note: The General Peace Treaty of Lima (30 October 1980) left the legal situation of the islands ('la situación jurídica insular') to the El Salvador–Honduras Joint Boundary Commission (art. 18.4) and, failing agreement within five years, to the ICJ (art. 31); the Special Agreement was filed with the Court on 11 December 1986, and its Chamber decided the Gulf of Fonseca islands on 11 September 1992. El Tigre (municipality of Amapala) had been occupied by Honduras since 1849. El Salvador claimed it before the Court; the Chamber rejected Honduras's argument that there was no real dispute over the island and held it Honduran.

ovr:tigri-area.name: Tigri Area (claimed by Suriname)
ovr:tigri-area.note: Administered by Guyana (East Berbice-Corentyne); claimed by Suriname (Coeroeni, Sipaliwini).

ovr:transnistria.name: Transnistria
ovr:transnistria.note: Unrecognised breakaway state, de facto independent of Moldova since the early 1990s; Russian troops stationed.

ovr:transnistria-dispute.name: Transnistria (breakaway; claimed by Moldova)
ovr:transnistria-dispute.note: De facto independent since the 1992 war (ceasefire 21 July 1992), with Bender on the right bank; internationally recognised as part of Moldova.

ovr:ukrainian-held-kursk-oblast.name: Ukrainian-held Kursk Oblast (claimed by Russia)
ovr:ukrainian-held-kursk-oblast.note: Taken in the incursion of August 2024; retaken by Russia by March–April 2025.

ovr:western-cherokee.name: Western Cherokee
ovr:western-cherokee.note: Approximate extent of the Western Cherokee (Old Settler) lands in Indian Territory, 1828-1838.
